title: School Library System
tagline: Role-based WPF library management with MSSQL backend
intro: University project: a library system with inventory, rentals, notifications, and admin controls.
summary: C# + WPF application with MSSQL that manages books, stock, and rentals. Role-based access for Students, Lecturers, and Admins with notification workflows.
features: Book rental lifecycle with time tracking
Notifications for returns and overdue items
Server deployment option for multi-device access

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A comprehensive WPF library system with MSSQL persistence, role-based access, and rental workflows.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Streamline library operations with secure access, clear inventories, and timely notifications.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Implemented roles, built inventory and rental modules, integrated MSSQL, and designed the WPF UI.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Role-confirmation flows; stock updates; rental timers; notification scheduler; validation rules.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Reduced manual overhead and demonstrated early competency in WPF, SQL, and OOP.
